name: application-item
title: Item
description: Composable list row primitive with an icon or avatar slot, a title/description text block, and a trailing action (link chevron, button, or checkbox).
useWhen: Building a settings list, member list, or option list where every row shares the same icon + text + action shape.
You want a single row primitive that can end in a navigation chevron, a button, or a checkbox without three different components.
Stacking rows inside a divided container (e.g. rounded-lg border with divide-y) to form a list.
avoidWhen: The row needs multiple independent columns of tabular data — use a table instead.
You need drag-and-drop reordering or nested rows — this is a flat, single-level row primitive.
responsiveBehavior: Text truncates with an ellipsis on narrow containers instead of wrapping; the row itself is a single flex line at all widths.
accessibility: Link-action rows render as a real <a> element so the whole row is keyboard-focusable and activatable, not just the chevron.
Checkbox-action rows wrap the row in a <label> so clicking anywhere in the row toggles the control, matching the visible hit target.
Icons are aria-hidden since the adjacent title text already conveys the row's purpose.

variants.title: Item
variants.description: Three stacked rows in a divided list: icon item with a navigation chevron, avatar item with a trailing remove button, and a selectable item with a checkbox.
accessibility: Each row's trailing action determines its interaction semantics: link, button, or checkbox.

variants.title: Item (Dark)
variants.description: The same three row types adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Row text and icon colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
